text.text: Production `payment-service` is failing with PostgreSQL `DB_CONN_TIMEOUT`/`PSQLException` errors from connection pool exhaustion on `postgres-primary`, plus `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` and `OOMKilled`/`CrashLoopBackOff` restarts in the `payment-service-7d9f84c9b6-rx2pm` pod. `api-gateway` is returning repeated `504` and `502` errors for `POST /api/v1/payments` and `auth-service` is also returning `401` due to `Redis session lookup timeout`, so the blast radius includes `payment-service`, `postgres-primary`, `api-gateway`, `auth-service`, and `redis-cache`. Overall severity is P1 with immediate user impact on payment submission, login/profile access, and degraded transaction availability; the single most critical next step is to stop or throttle `POST /api/v1/payments` traffic at `api-gateway` while `postgres-primary` is at `195/200` connections and `payment-service` is unstable.

*Issues Identified:*
• *DB_TIMEOUT* on `payment-service, postgres-primary, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *OOM_KILL* on `payment-service, kubelet, kubernetes` — P1 (confidence: 99%)
• *NETWORK_ERROR* on `api-gateway, payment-service` — P1 (confidence: 90%)
• *AUTH_ERROR* on `auth-service, redis-cache, api-gateway` — P1 (confidence: 96%)
• *DEPLOY_FAILURE* on `deployment-controller, payment-service, kubernetes` — P2 (confidence: 88%)
